t: This is the University College London Department of Security and Crime Science. It carries the name of Jill Dando, the English journalist, television presenter and newsreader who spent most of her career at the BBC. In 1997 the BBC named her its Personality of the Year. At the time of her death in 1999 she was co-presenting Crimewatch on BBC One with Nick Ross. Her name is linked to this department in her memory.
